title: Can Deception Detection Go Deeper? Dataset, Evaluation, and Benchmark for Deception Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on deception reasoning, which involves identifying factual inconsistencies and intent. The evaluation metrics (accuracy, completeness, logic, depth) are technical and do not benchmark or evaluate LLMs on religion, faith, morals, or ethical frameworks. The brief 'Societal Impacts' section is a general discussion, not an evaluation component.
